item.title: 14. Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
item.description:
SVD is the most general and numerically stable factorization, defined for any matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, square or rectangular.

Definition

$$ A = U \Sigma V^T, $$

where

  • $U$ is $m \times m$ orthogonal,
  • $V$ is $n \times n$ orthogonal,
  • $\Sigma$ is $m \times n$ diagonal with singular values $\sigma_1 \ge \cdots \ge 0$.

The nonzero $\sigma_i$ are square roots of eigenvalues of $A^T A$.
